"""Archive whole completed and failed promoted Gena evidence without replaying it."""
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = P.parents[1]
W = ROOT / '.direnv/friendly-command-gena'
manifest = W / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-promoted-installed-proof-archive.json'
assert not manifest.exists()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
names = set()
for path in P.iterdir():
    if path.is_file() and (path.name.startswith(('friendly-command-gena-promoted-', 'gena-output-type-', 'gena-installed-', 'gena-promoted-'))
                          or 'friendly_command_gena_promoted' in path.name
                          or path.name in ('verify_gena_completed_nix_outputs.py', 'audit_gena_installed_cohort_streams.py', 'friendly-command-gena-browser.mjs')):
        names.add(path.name)
def references(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            references(key)
            references(item)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            references(item)
    elif isinstance(value, str) and len(value) < 1024 and '\n' not in value:
        path = Path(value)
        path = path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path
        if path.parent == P and path.is_file():
            names.add(path.name)
for name in list(names):
    if name.endswith(('.json', '.json.gz')) and '-original-' not in name:
        payload = (P / name).read_bytes()
        references(json.loads(gzip.decompress(payload) if name.endswith('.gz') else payload))
files = {}
destination = W / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-promoted-installed-proof'
destination.mkdir()
for name in sorted(names):
    raw = (P / name).read_bytes()
    packed = gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)
    path = destination / (name + '.gz')
    path.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()) == raw
    files[name] = dict(path=str(path.relative_to(W / 'docs')), source_sha256=sha(raw),
                       archive_sha256=sha(packed), bytes=len(raw))
manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(
    state='complete-original-success-and-failure-evidence-preserved',
    captured_head='2e366b9fbe80ab299e1540792fe3f409802900f0',
    files=files, original_failed_wrappers_remain_failed=True,
    completed_commands=236, complete_command_streams=472,
    reused_completed_commands=149, prefix_command_replays=0,
    scope='Historical promoted Gena capture; portable audit and current integration are separate checks. No contextual judgments added.',
    producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(), sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
    archived_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()),
    ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files), manifest_sha256=sha(manifest.read_bytes()),
                      archive_bytes=sum((W / 'docs' / row['path']).stat().st_size for row in files.values()))))
